publication.title: Diuqin lechiguanae gen. et sp. nov., a new unenlagiine (Theropoda: Paraves) from the Bajo de la Carpa Formation (Neuquén Group, Upper Cretaceous) of Neuquén Province, Patagonia, Argentina
authors: D. D. dos Santos, F. A. Gianechini, M. Pittman, M. C. Lamanna

locality.name: PBDB collection 235260: The specimen was collected from the isthmus between the southeast coast of Lago Barreales and the northwest coast of Lago Mari Menuco, in Neuquén Province, northwestern Patagonia, Argentina, from a stratum of the Bajo de la Carpa Formation of the Neuquén Group (Upper Cretaceous: Santonian.

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 235260 to Santonian with numeric bounds 85.7–83.6 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 88651; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.
